title: The Hirt band's beards and the fun of the job
summary: The beard idea for Mardi Gras, who kept theirs, and Coquille's praise of Hirt's humor and the six-hour nights.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: That's the records. That's the only ones that I'm on with Al and Pete. The volume one and two of Audio Fidelity, long playing record. And a verve, long playing with Pete and Alhurt. And that verve, I understand the cover's been changed. They had all... They all had... On a verve, original verve, they had all the bus pictures of all of them and the band on the back of the cover. And on a verve, all the fellas in the group had a beard because that's when they first raised the beards. Except Paul Edwards and myself, the drummer and myself, we didn't raise beards because we have gray hair and we would have looked like Blackstone, a magician if we would have raised a beard, I guess. So instead, I think I raised a mustache for a while, but I shaved the mustache off about four months later. But that's when Al and Pete and the rest of the guys first decided on a beard. It was Al's idea about the beard because it was about three months before Mardi Gras. Al said, let's all raise a beard. And on Mardi Gras Day, we're going to play in the daytime besides at night and we'll dress like Arabs, you know. And that's when they first started and to this day, they still have it. That is, Al and Pete still have it. Pete has the Van Dyke type and, of course, Al let his grow all over. And Bob Havens and Roy Zimmerman, of course, have since shaved theirs off. And Paul Edwards and myself, well, we never did raise a beard. But to this day, Al and Pete still have their beard. And that's back in the...
Well, did they ever do anything for kicks like that?
Oh, he just thought it would be a kick to do that. That's all. It was just a deal for Mardi Gras, which was coming up three months later. And then they decided to keep the beard.
So they would enjoy Mardi Gras even if they're playing music.
Right. Right. They just decided to keep the beard after that and they never would shave it off.
It wasn't just another job for them, is what I'm getting to say.
You know, some people never have any fun. Never had the impression that Pete found...

We had a lot of fun on the band. Al has a good... Al Heard has a real good sense of humor. And it was a fun night every night. And I mean, we really worked, but we enjoyed it. We worked six hours a night. We worked from nine to three. We weren't doing one show a night, four nights a week like Al was doing now. We were working six hours a night. But I enjoyed it. I really enjoyed it. Because Al made the job a fun job and we all had a good time. And Al has a heart of gold. He's a good-natured guy.
